description: One call that returns a completed audit's SUMMARY, full per-section DETAIL, and deduplicated prioritized FIXES together — so you don't have to chain get_audit → get_audit_detail → get_fixes. Use `expand` to trim the payload ('summary' | 'detail' | 'fixes' | 'all'; default 'all'). Same ownership, tier gating, and sanitization as those tools. For an in-progress audit it returns the status so you can keep polling. The detail layer includes Wave-B surfaced sections (author/E-E-A-T, freshness, images, hreflang, per-bot access, Action microformats, OpenAPI sub-metrics, Google Intelligence, product readability, site maturity, methodology) and Wave-C deterministic signals (content quality, video/locale, USE sub-metrics, trust claims) each with an availability state.

audit_id.description: The audit_id returned by run_audit / compare_aeo (poll until status is completed).

name: get_audit_full

outputSchema.description: When the audit is still running, only audit_id + status are returned (plus a poll pointer). When complete, the combined envelope below is returned with the sections selected by `expand`.

detail.description: Full per-section detail (present unless trimmed by expand).

agentic_detail.description: Agentic readiness: structured_data, trust, mcp_readiness, agent_card, use_probes, trust_claims.

availability.description: Per-section availability state map (present | not_detected | not_run_free_tier | ...).

competitors.description: Competitor cluster (named on paid tiers; coarse bucket otherwise).

dropped_sections.description: Names of sections shed for size.

experimental_fields.description: Composite *_score paths whose methodology may change without a schema bump.

methodology.description: Scoring version, pillar weights, the USE rebuild recipe (use_rollup: detail-path weights + ordered rules), find_rollup {status, weights, inputs} (pillar FIND ≈ round(Σ weights[k]×inputs[k]); status is an open enum — only "ok" guarantees weights/inputs, treat any other value as not rebuildable), and methodology notes.

page_signals.description: Per-page rollups: author/E-E-A-T, freshness, images, hreflang, video, locale schema.

product_readability.description: Product-page readability score + coverage + top issues.

tool_description_quality.description: LLM-judged MCP tool-description quality (OMITTED unless state 'judged').

truncated.description: True if any sections were shed to fit the byte cap.

fixes.description: Canonical fix list (present unless trimmed by expand).

findingId.description: SPM stable finding id (e.g. 'read:rendered_schema_gap'), null if unstamped.

suggested_next_calls.description: Advisory next-tool-call pointers (suggested_next_calls). Score-neutral agent UX.

reason.description: Why this is the natural next step.

summary.description: Lean summary (present unless trimmed by expand).

provisional_note.description: On a partial audit, a short note explaining the scores are provisional and how to get a fresh run; null otherwise.

scores_provisional.description: True when the audit finished with status 'partial' (some audit steps failed), so scores are provisional. Reflects the stored status only — false is not a reliability guarantee.

summary.description: Short natural-language summary (capped at a word boundary).

summary_truncated.description: True when the summary was clipped to the cap (ends with an ellipsis).

title: Get Full Audit Report
